items.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
items.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham vows to support Ukraine in its "hour of need" after Russia accuses the UK of escalating the Ukraine war by supplying British-made drones.
